summary: preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727KB sibling payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime tarball from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (bun-v1.3.13), extracts the bun/bun.exe binary to a temporary directory, chmod +x's it, and invokes it via execFileSync against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a single-line, ~727KB obfuscator.io-style bundle (rotated string array with shift routine, custom-alphabet char-code decoder, randomised identifiers) whose behavior is not observable without deobfuscation. The package advertises itself as a Jest preset for React Native, which has no need for the Bun runtime. Running `npm install` on this version therefore fetches a second language runtime and uses it to execute an opaque payload on the installer host at install time — an alternate-runtime dropper pattern that evades Node-based scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
